And we are not for the first time for this place...

reviews.snippet:
I recently dined at Food Factory, and it was an absolutely fantastic experience from start to finish.
The Food: The food quality is top-notch. Every dish was prepared to perfection, bursting with authentic flavours and freshness. The taste truly exceeded my expectations, making it a highly memorable meal.
The Service, What made the visit even more special was the exceptional service. A huge shoutout to Manjunath from the kitchen staff! He went above and beyond to ensure our meal was perfect. His attentiveness, warm hospitality, and dedication to customer satisfaction were highly impressive.
I will definitely be returning soon. Highly recommended for anyone looking for incredible food and stellar service!

reviews.snippet: Recently, we visited this Food Factory along with my office colleagues for a retirement outing party. It offers a great dining experience with a wide variety of both vegetarian and non-vegetarian dishes. We tried both, along with drinks, and found the food to be tasty, fresh, and well-prepared. However, we received some feedback that the fish dishes were not up to expectations. The service was prompt, and the staff were friendly and attentive. Overall, it’s a nice place for everyone to enjoy a satisfying meal.

response.snippet:
We are sorry to hear about your experience and understand your concern regarding the missing cash. The safety and trust of our guests are extremely important to us.

We would like to clarify that the valet parking service is operated by an independent third-party agency.
However, we take all customer concerns seriously and do not dismiss any complaint related to services provided on our premises.

* As soon as the matter was brought to our attention, we cooperated with you and informed the Local jurisdiction Police station as well as valet agency so that a proper investigation could be conducted. 
* You were very confused and misinterpreted twice by saying the lost money was Rs.8,000 and then again you changed it by saying Rs. 15,500.
* But still we valued your time and money and contacted the police to arrive at our restaurant.
* They did arrive but you were not ready to explain and co-operate with the police officer. You just left suddenly in car without proper intimation or anything.

So this is where the doubt arises as well as confusion builds up.

Making Allegations is simple, but one has to STAND FOR the words spoken.


We value all our guests and are committed to maintaining a safe and pleasant experience for everyone.

reviews.snippet: The Food Factory serves delicious food with rich flavors and generous portions. Right from the entry, valet parking and the staff’s warm welcome make a great first impression. The place offers plenty of seating options — ground floor huts, an open space on the first floor, and a cozy AC cabin at the top. The ambience is very pleasant, and the service is quick with staff who are friendly and attentive. It’s a great spot to hang out with friends and family. Prices are slightly on the higher side, but the  and quality of the food make it worth it. Recommended to  Try  mutton nati fry , prawns butter garlic very tasty,  nachos,  crispy corn,  potato chicken chili,  kasthuri paneer,  mutton biryani,

reviews.snippet:
Food factory in  aerodrome in Bangalore.I would not even give this place one star. The food quality was very poor, and the overall experience was disappointing.

The environment was noisy, with many people smoking and drinking, making it unsuitable for families. The chicken that was served was hard, had an unpleasant smell, and appeared to be made from old or stale meat.

The prices are quite high considering the poor food quality and overall experience. I would not recommend this place, especially for families looking for a comfortable dining experience.

reviews.snippet:
We used to like the food at Food Factory, Jakkur… but once we met *Manjunath*, we started _loving_ it.

He’s incredibly patient, listens to what we like, and always recommends the best dishes for our taste. Even when the place is packed, he makes sure the service is perfect — refills, timing, everything.

More than anything, Manju is genuinely kind and a great human being. He’s certainly an asset to Food Factory near Jakkur. Because of him, this is now our go-to spot. Thank you, Manju! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Food is amazing and so was the service.. This dhaba serves delicious food with rich flavors and generous portions. The casual, rustic ambiance adds to the experience, making it feel like a true taste of India. A perfect spot for hearty meals, from spicy curries to sea food dishes.

Captain Siddaraju is been so humble and so good in service and suggesting good dishes .
